     8	/-!
     9	# The Jacobian representability datum (Wave-4 seam D1, `JacobianData`)
    10	
    11	The pinned representability datum for the degree-zero étale-sheafified relative Picard
    12	functor `pic0Functor C` of the challenge curve: a representing object `J`, an honest
    13	`Functor.RepresentableBy` datum (no `Nonempty`, no choice), and the two construction
    14	certificates (`LocallyOfFiniteType`, `QuasiCompact`).  This is the frozen Wave-4
    15	interface shape (`informal/w4-datum-worksheet.md` §1.1, verbatim), together with the
    16	design-§5 consumers `grpObj` / `homEquiv` / `uniqueUpToIso` — and nothing else.
    17	
    18	## Ownership split (binding, w5-worksheet D1)
    19	
    20	* The **producer** `jacobianData C : JacobianData C`, the quasi-compactness certificate,
    21	  and the discharge of the frozen `Jacobian`/`instGrpObj` sorries of `Challenge.lean`
    22	  are **DAT-J property** (the parallel Wave-4 fleet).  None of them lives here.
    23	* This file is the **Wave-5/6/7 consumption interface**: downstream files take
    24	  `(d : JacobianData C)` as a section variable, activate the group structure per proof
    25	  via `letI := d.grpObj` (or `attribute [local instance] JacobianData.grpObj`), and
    26	  phrase every statement about `d.J`.  At DAT-J discharge time the frozen gate
    27	  instantiates them by `exact theorem_x … (jacobianData C)` — definitionally, since
    28	  `Jacobian C := (jacobianData C).J`.
    29	* Extensions to this file are **additive only**; the structure shape never changes.
    30	
    31	## The `forget₂ ⋙ forget` massage
    32	
    33	`rep` is typed against `(pic0Functor C ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) ⋙ forget GrpCat`
    34	so that mathlib's `GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy` applies **verbatim** with
    35	`F := pic0Functor C ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat`.  The functor value at a test `T` is
    36	*definitionally* the coerced subgroup `↥(pic0Subgroup C T)`; `homEquiv` and
    37	`homEquiv_comp` below own this defeq once, exposing the equivalence against
    38	`pic0Subgroup C T` and the naturality against `pic0Map` — no consumer ever meets the
    39	`forget₂ ⋙ forget` spelling again.
    40	
    41	## η-defeq verdict (recon §5 "lower-order unknown", RECORDED)
    42	
    43	**POSITIVE, with one keying caveat.**  `Over.mk d.J.hom` is definitionally equal to
    44	`d.J` (structure-eta for `Comma`/`CostructuredArrow` plus unit-like eta for the
    45	`Discrete PUnit` right leg): the ascription
    46	`(d.grpObj : GrpObj (Over.mk d.J.hom))` elaborates as-is, so **no transport lemma is
    47	ever needed**.  Caveat: bare instance *search* does not unfold `Over.mk` on its own,
    48	so a consumer of `smooth_of_grpObj` — whose group hypothesis is `[GrpObj (Over.mk f)]`
    49	at `f := d.J.hom` — must key the instance at the `Over.mk` spelling:
    50	`letI : GrpObj (Over.mk d.J.hom) := d.grpObj` (pure defeq, zero cost; mathlib itself
    51	uses the same ascription idiom in `Group/Smooth.lean`).  Instances stated directly on
    52	`G : Over (Spec (.of K))` (e.g. `IsClosedImmersion η[G].left`) fire on `d.J` with no
    53	massage at all.  The `example`-level smoke tests at the bottom of this file are the
    54	machine-checked record; the T-chain (tangent lane) and S2 (`Smooth` via
    55	`smooth_of_grpObj`) may rely on this freely.
    56	
    57	## Main declarations
    58	
    59	* `AlgebraicGeometry.JacobianData C` — the frozen datum structure.
    60	* `AlgebraicGeometry.JacobianData.grpObj` — the group-object structure on `d.J` via
    61	  `GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy` (the discharge route of the frozen `instGrpObj`).
    62	* `AlgebraicGeometry.JacobianData.homEquiv` / `homEquiv_comp` — the universal property
    63	  in consumer form: `(T ⟶ d.J) ≃ pic0Subgroup C T`, natural against `pic0Map`.
    64	* `AlgebraicGeometry.JacobianData.uniqueUpToIso` / `homEquiv_uniqueUpToIso_hom` — any
    65	  two data have canonically isomorphic representing objects (Wave-7's `baseChangeIso`
    66	  mechanism), with the intertwining property.
    67	-/
    68	
    69	set_option autoImplicit false
    70	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    71	
    72	universe u
    73	
    74	open CategoryTheory Opposite
    75	
    76	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    77	
    78	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
    79	
    80	/-- **The pinned representability datum** for the degree-zero étale-sheafified relative
    81	Picard functor of the curve `C` (w4-datum-worksheet §1.1, frozen).  Produced once, by
    82	explicit construction, in Wave 4 (DAT-J: `jacobianData`); consumed as a section
    83	variable everywhere else.  NEVER a sorried instance, NEVER `Nonempty` + choice.
    84	
    85	The typing of `rep` is chosen so that `GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy` applies verbatim with
    86	`F := pic0Functor C ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat` (see `JacobianData.grpObj`). -/
    87	structure JacobianData (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    88	    [IsProper C.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] :
    89	    Type (u + 1) where
    90	  /-- The representing object (the Jacobian-to-be). -/
    91	  J : Over (Spec (.of k))
    92	  /-- The pinned universal datum: `Hom(T, J) ≃ Pic⁰(T)`, naturally in the test `T`. -/
    93	  rep : ((pic0Functor C ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) ⋙ forget GrpCat).RepresentableBy J
    94	  /-- Certificate from the construction (Kleiman 4.8(1) shape); NOT re-derived via the
    95	  EGA limit criterion. -/
    96	  locallyOfFiniteType : LocallyOfFiniteType J.hom
    97	  /-- Certificate from the construction (a posteriori: `|J|` is the image of a
    98	  quasi-compact divisor scheme under the Abel map).  Feeds `IsProper` (Wave 5) via
    99	  `finite type = qc + lft`. -/
   100	  quasiCompact : QuasiCompact J.hom
   101	
   102	namespace JacobianData
   103	
   104	variable {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   105	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   106	
   107	/-- The group-object structure on the representing object, via mathlib's
   108	`GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy` — this is the (definitional) discharge route of the frozen
   109	`Jacobian.instGrpObj`.  Not a global instance here (the datum is a section variable);
   110	activate per proof with `letI := d.grpObj` or
   111	`attribute [local instance] JacobianData.grpObj`. -/
   112	@[implicit_reducible]
   113	noncomputable def grpObj (d : JacobianData C) : GrpObj d.J :=
   114	  GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy d.J (pic0Functor C ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) d.rep
   115	
   116	/-- **The universal property, consumer form**: morphisms into `d.J` are degree-zero
   117	étale Picard classes.  This accessor owns the `forget₂ ⋙ forget` defeq massage once:
   118	the target is the honest subgroup carrier `pic0Subgroup C T`. -/
   119	def homEquiv (d : JacobianData C) {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} :
   120	    (T ⟶ d.J) ≃ pic0Subgroup C T :=
   121	  d.rep.homEquiv
   122	
   123	/-- Naturality of `homEquiv` against the degree-zero restriction maps `pic0Map`
   124	(element form of the `RepresentableBy` naturality, with the functor value unfolded
   125	through `forget₂ ⋙ forget`). -/
   126	theorem homEquiv_comp (d : JacobianData C) {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   127	    (f : T' ⟶ T) (g : T ⟶ d.J) :
   128	    d.homEquiv (f ≫ g) = pic0Map C f (d.homEquiv g) :=
   129	  d.rep.homEquiv_comp f g
   130	
   131	/-- Representing objects are unique up to isomorphism (mathlib
   132	`Functor.RepresentableBy.uniqueUpToIso`): any two Jacobian data for the same curve have
   133	canonically isomorphic `J`.  This is Wave-7's `baseChangeIso` mechanism. -/
   134	noncomputable def uniqueUpToIso (d d' : JacobianData C) : d.J ≅ d'.J :=
   135	  d.rep.uniqueUpToIso d'.rep
   136	
   137	/-- The intertwining property of `uniqueUpToIso`: composing with the canonical
   138	isomorphism commutes with the two universal properties. -/
   139	theorem homEquiv_uniqueUpToIso_hom (d d' : JacobianData C) {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   140	    (f : T ⟶ d.J) :
   141	    d'.homEquiv (f ≫ (d.uniqueUpToIso d').hom) = d.homEquiv f := by
   142	  have h : (d.uniqueUpToIso d').hom = d'.rep.homEquiv.symm (d.rep.homEquiv (𝟙 d.J)) := rfl
   143	  rw [homEquiv, homEquiv, h, Functor.RepresentableBy.comp_homEquiv_symm]
   144	  exact (d'.rep.homEquiv.apply_symm_apply _).trans (d.rep.homEquiv_eq f).symm
   145	
   146	end JacobianData

    21	The last module agrees with the previously landed `chartColengthModule`.  No flatness or
    22	fibre-injectivity statement is made here: those properties for the `R`-linear range do not
    23	automatically pass to this `B`-ideal.
    24	-/
    25	
    26	set_option autoImplicit false
    27	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    28	
    29	universe uR uB uM uN u
    30	
    31	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite
    32	open scoped TensorProduct
    33	
    34	namespace LinearMap
    35	
    36	/-- The range of scalar extension is the span, over the new scalar ring, of the original
    37	range.  In particular, this is the precise map presenting the ideal generated by an
    38	`R`-linear family of elements of an `R`-algebra. -/
    39	theorem range_liftBaseChange_eq_span
    40	    {R : Type uR} {B : Type uB} {M : Type uM} {N : Type uN}
    41	    [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    42	    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    43	    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Module B N] [IsScalarTower R B N]
    44	    (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    45	    LinearMap.range (LinearMap.liftBaseChange B f) =
    46	      Submodule.span B (Set.range f) := by
    47	  apply le_antisymm
    48	  · rintro y ⟨x, rfl⟩
    49	    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    50	    | zero => exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    51	    | add x y hx hy =>
    52	        simpa only [map_add] using Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
    53	    | tmul b m =>
    54	        rw [LinearMap.liftBaseChange_tmul]
    55	        exact Submodule.smul_mem _ b (Submodule.subset_span ⟨m, rfl⟩)
    56	  · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    57	    rintro _ ⟨m, rfl⟩
    58	    exact ⟨(1 : B) ⊗ₜ[R] m, by
    59	      rw [LinearMap.liftBaseChange_tmul, one_smul]⟩
    60	
    61	end LinearMap

    63	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    64	
    65	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    66	
    67	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    68	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
    69	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π] {a : ℕ}
    70	
    71	namespace ThetaGeneratorSeed
    72	
    73	/-- The genuine chart-ring ideal generated by the readings of `K`.  This is generally larger
    74	than the `R`-linear range of `chartReadMap K b`. -/
    75	noncomputable def chartReadIdeal
    76	    (K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)) (b : Bool) :
    77	    Ideal Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b) :=
    78	  Ideal.span (Set.range (chartReadMap K b))
    79	
    80	/-- The minimal scalar-extension map presenting the ideal generated by the chart readings:
    81	`c ⊗ ψ ↦ c · read(ψ)`. -/
    82	noncomputable def chartReadIdealMap
    83	    (K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)) (b : Bool) :
    84	    Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b) ⊗[R] ↥K →ₗ[Γ(relCurve C R,
    85	      relPinnedChart C R π b)] Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b) :=
    86	  LinearMap.liftBaseChange Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b) (chartReadMap K b)
    87	
    88	set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
    89	/-- The range of `chartReadIdealMap` is exactly the genuine chart-reading ideal. -/
    90	theorem range_chartReadIdealMap
    91	    (K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)) (b : Bool) :
    92	    LinearMap.range (chartReadIdealMap K b) = chartReadIdeal K b := by
    93	  simpa only [chartReadIdealMap, chartReadIdeal] using
    94	    (LinearMap.range_liftBaseChange_eq_span
    95	      (R := R) (B := Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b))
    96	      (M := ↥K) (N := Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b))
    97	      (chartReadMap K b))
    98	
    99	/-- The image of the genuine chart-reading ideal in the colength ring
   100	`B ⧸ Ideal.span {read s}`.  Equivalently, this is `(chartReadIdeal K b + (read s)) / (read s)`,
   101	viewed as a `B`-submodule of the quotient. -/
   102	noncomputable def chartIdealColengthModule
   103	    (K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)) (b : Bool)
   104	    (s : relThetaSections C R π a) :
   105	    Submodule Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b)
   106	      (Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b) ⧸
   107	        Ideal.span {relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) s}) :=
   108	  Submodule.map
   109	    (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b)
   110	      (Ideal.span {relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) s})).toLinearMap
   111	    (chartReadIdeal K b)
   112	
   113	/-- The ideal-theoretic colength module is exactly the previously defined `B`-span of the
   114	classes of the chart readings. -/
   115	theorem chartIdealColengthModule_eq_chartColengthModule
   116	    (K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)) (b : Bool)
   117	    (s : relThetaSections C R π a) :
   118	    chartIdealColengthModule K b s = chartColengthModule K b s := by
   119	  rw [chartIdealColengthModule, chartReadIdeal, Submodule.map_span, chartColengthModule]
   120	  congr 1
   121	  ext x
   122	  constructor
   123	  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨m, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
   124	    exact ⟨m, rfl⟩
   125	  · rintro ⟨m, rfl⟩
   126	    exact ⟨chartReadMap K b m, ⟨m, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
   127	
   128	/-- The scalar-extension presentation of the chart-reading ideal after quotienting by the
   129	chosen section. -/
   130	noncomputable def chartIdealColengthMap
   131	    (K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)) (b : Bool)
   132	    (s : relThetaSections C R π a) :
   133	    Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b) ⊗[R] ↥K →ₗ[Γ(relCurve C R,
   134	      relPinnedChart C R π b)]
   135	      (Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b) ⧸
   136	        Ideal.span {relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) s}) :=
   137	  LinearMap.liftBaseChange Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b)
   138	    ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R (Ideal.span {relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) s})).toLinearMap.comp
   139	      (chartReadMap K b))
   140	
   141	set_option maxHeartbeats 2400000 in
   142	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 800000 in
   143	/-- The range of the quotient scalar-extension map is the ideal-theoretic colength module. -/
   144	theorem range_chartIdealColengthMap
   145	    (K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)) (b : Bool)
   146	    (s : relThetaSections C R π a) :
   147	    LinearMap.range (chartIdealColengthMap K b s) = chartIdealColengthModule K b s := by
   148	  rw [chartIdealColengthModule_eq_chartColengthModule]
   149	  simpa only [chartIdealColengthMap, chartColengthModule] using
   150	    (LinearMap.range_liftBaseChange_eq_span
   151	      (R := R) (B := Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b))
   152	      (M := ↥K)
   153	      (N := Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b) ⧸
   154	        Ideal.span {relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) s})
   155	      ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R
   156	        (Ideal.span {relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) s})).toLinearMap.comp
   157	          (chartReadMap K b)))
   158	
   159	end ThetaGeneratorSeed
   160	
   161	end AlgebraicGeometry

    10	/-!
    11	# The universal multiplication span
    12	
    13	This file records the relative product map from the multiplier window and the
    14	universal first window into the universal shifted window.  The map is written
    15	using a finite basis of the multiplier space; its range is therefore the
    16	finite `R_Z`-linear multiplication span.  The carve containment is proved in
    17	the companion theorem below.
    18	-/
    19	
    20	set_option autoImplicit false
    21	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    22	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 8
    23	
    24	universe u
    25	
    26	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite
    27	open scoped TensorProduct
    28	
    29	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    30	
    31	open Scheme Grassmannian
    32	
    33	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    34	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π]
    35	
    36	noncomputable local instance instOverCleftMulSpan :
    37	    C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
    38	
    39	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsIntegral C.left]
    40	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    41	  [IsDominant π]
    42	variable [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0)]
    43	  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]
    44	variable (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    45	variable (g r₁ r₂ : ℕ)
    46	variable (b₁ : Module.Basis (Fin r₁) k
    47	  ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤))
    48	variable (b₂ : Module.Basis (Fin r₂) k
    49	  ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k ((windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
    50	    + (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)) ⊤))
    51	variable (i : (glueData k g r₁).J) (j : (glueData k g r₂).J)
    52	
    53	local notation "RZ" => DivCarveChartRing k
    54	  (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
    55	  (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j
    56	local notation "HS" => ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k
    57	  (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤)
    58	local notation "HM" => ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k
    59	  (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤)
    60	local notation "HMS" => ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k
    61	  ((windowM_choice π hπ g + windowS_choice π hπ g) • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤)
    62	local notation "K₁" => ↥(divUniversalFstWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule
    63	local notation "K₂" => ↥(divUniversalSndWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule
    64	
    65	/-! ## The finite source and its multiplication map -/
    66	
    67	/-- A finite free-indexed source for the universal multiplication span. -/
    68	noncomputable def universalMulSource : Type u := Fin (Module.finrank k HS) → K₁
    69	
    70	/-- The sum of all multiplier-basis translates of the first universal window. -/
    71	noncomputable def universalMulMap : universalMulSource C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j →ₗ[RZ]
    72	    RZ ⊗[k] HMS :=
    73	  ∑ t : Fin (Module.finrank k HS),
    74	    (LinearMap.baseChange RZ (windowShiftMul hπ g ((Module.finBasis k HS) t))).comp
    75	      ((divUniversalFstWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule.subtype.comp
    76	        (LinearMap.proj t))
    77	
    78	/-- The relative submodule spanned by all products of a multiplier-window
    79	basis vector with the universal first window. -/
    80	noncomputable def universalMulSpan : Submodule RZ (RZ ⊗[k] HMS) :=
    81	  LinearMap.range (universalMulMap C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j)
    82	
    83	theorem finite_universalMulSource :
    84	    Module.Finite RZ (universalMulSource C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j) := by
    85	  letI := (divUniversalFstWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).finite_quotient
    86	  letI := (divUniversalFstWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).projective_quotient
    87	  letI : Module.Finite RZ K₁ :=
    88	    finite_submodule_of_projective_quotient
    89	      (divUniversalFstWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule
    90	  infer_instance
    91	
    92	/-! ## Carve containment -/
    93	
    94	/-- The coordinate universal pair satisfies the carve over its chart ring. -/
    95	private theorem universal_coordinate_carve (a : HS) :
    96	    carvePairArrow
    97	        (divCarveMul k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
    98	          (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ a)
    99	        (divUniversalFst k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
   100	          (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule
   101	        (divUniversalSnd k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
   102	          (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule = 0 := by
   103	  change carvePairArrow
   104	      (divCarveMul k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
   105	        (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ a)
   106	      (LinearMap.ker (Module.Grassmannian.baseChangeMkQ RZ
   107	        (pairTautFst k g r₁ r₂ i j).toSubmodule))
   108	      (LinearMap.ker (Module.Grassmannian.baseChangeMkQ RZ
   109	        (pairTautSnd k g r₁ r₂ i j).toSubmodule)) = 0
   110	  exact divUniversal_carve k
   111	    (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
   112	    (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j RZ a
   113	
   114	/-- The universal pair in the transported window ambients satisfies the
   115	`windowShiftMul` carve. -/
   116	theorem universal_window_carve (a : HS) :
   117	    carvePairArrow (windowShiftMul hπ g a)
   118	      (divUniversalFstWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule
   119	      (divUniversalSndWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule = 0 := by
   120	  let e₁ : (Fin r₁ → k) ≃ₗ[k] HM := b₁.equivFun.symm
   121	  let e₂ : (Fin r₂ → k) ≃ₗ[k] HMS :=
   122	    b₂.equivFun.symm.trans (seedWindowShiftEquiv C π hπ g)
   123	  let μ : (Fin r₁ → k) →ₗ[k] (Fin r₂ → k) :=
   124	    divCarveMul k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
   125	      (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ a
   126	  have hμ : e₂.toLinearMap ∘ₗ μ ∘ₗ e₁.symm.toLinearMap = windowShiftMul hπ g a := by
   127	    refine LinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
   128	    simp [e₁, e₂, μ, divCarveMul, windowShiftMul, LinearMap.comp_apply]
   129	  have hcoord := universal_coordinate_carve C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j a
   130	  have htransport :=
   131	    (Grassmannian.carvePairArrow_map_baseChange_eq_zero_iff e₁ e₂ μ
   132	      (divUniversalFst k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
   133	        (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule
   134	      (divUniversalSnd k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
   135	        (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule).mpr hcoord
   136	  rw [hμ] at htransport
   137	  exact htransport
   138	
   139	/-! ## The span containment -/
   140	
   141	theorem universalMulMap_range_le :
   142	    LinearMap.range (universalMulMap C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j) ≤
   143	      (divUniversalSndWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule := by
   144	  rw [LinearMap.range_le_iff]
   145	  intro v
   146	  rw [universalMulMap]
   147	  apply Submodule.sum_mem
   148	  intro t ht
   149	  have hcarve := carvePairArrow_eq_zero_iff (R := RZ)
   150	    (windowShiftMul hπ g ((Module.finBasis k HS) t))
   151	    (divUniversalFstWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule
   152	    (divUniversalSndWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule |>.mp
   153	    (universal_window_carve C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j ((Module.finBasis k HS) t))
   154	  exact hcarve (v t).1 (v t).2
   155	
   156	theorem universalMulSpan_le :
   157	    universalMulSpan C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j ≤
   158	      (divUniversalSndWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule := by
   159	  exact universalMulMap_range_le C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j
   160	
   161	/-- The product map corestricted to the universal second window.  Its residue-
   162	field surjectivity is the only remaining input needed by
   163	`RigidEngine.surjective_of_forall_rTensor_residueField_surjective`. -/
   164	noncomputable def universalMulMapToSnd :
   165	    universalMulSource C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j →ₗ[RZ] K₂ :=
   166	  (universalMulMap C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).codRestrict _ fun v =>
   167	    universalMulMap_range_le C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j
   168	      (LinearMap.mem_range_self _ v)
   169	
   170	theorem finite_universalMulSpan :
   171	    Module.Finite RZ ↥(universalMulSpan C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j) := by
   172	  letI := finite_universalMulSource C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j
   173	  infer_instance
   174	
   175	end AlgebraicGeometry

    12	/-!
    13	# The residue-fibre multiplication map
    14	
    15	This file isolates the tensor bookkeeping between the finite relative product
    16	map and the field-level multiplication-span theorem.  Tensoring the finite
    17	product source commutes with its finite product, and under that equivalence the
    18	base-changed map is the sum of the base-changed multiplier-basis components.
    19	-/
    20	
    21	set_option autoImplicit false
    22	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    23	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 8
    24	
    25	universe u
    26	
    27	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite
    28	open scoped TensorProduct
    29	
    30	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    31	
    32	open Scheme Grassmannian
    33	
    34	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    35	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π]
    36	
    37	noncomputable local instance instOverCleftMulSpanFibre :
    38	    C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
    39	
    40	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsIntegral C.left]
    41	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    42	  [IsDominant π]
    43	variable [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0)]
    44	  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]
    45	variable (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    46	variable (g r₁ r₂ : ℕ)
    47	variable (b₁ : Module.Basis (Fin r₁) k
    48	  ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤))
    49	variable (b₂ : Module.Basis (Fin r₂) k
    50	  ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k ((windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
    51	    + (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)) ⊤))
    52	variable (i : (glueData k g r₁).J) (j : (glueData k g r₂).J)
    53	
    54	local notation "RZ" => DivCarveChartRing k
    55	  (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
    56	  (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j
    57	local notation "HS" => ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k
    58	  (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤)
    59	local notation "HMS" => ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k
    60	  ((windowM_choice π hπ g + windowS_choice π hπ g) • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤)
    61	local notation "K₁" => ↥(divUniversalFstWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule
    62	local notation "K₂" => ↥(divUniversalSndWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule
    63	
    64	/-- The `t`-th multiplier-basis component of the relative product map. -/
    65	noncomputable def universalMulComponent
    66	    (t : Fin (Module.finrank k HS)) : K₁ →ₗ[RZ] RZ ⊗[k] HMS :=
    67	  (LinearMap.baseChange RZ (windowShiftMul hπ g ((Module.finBasis k HS) t))).comp
    68	    (divUniversalFstWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule.subtype
    69	
    70	/-- Scalar extension commutes with the finite product used as the source of
    71	`universalMulMap`. -/
    72	noncomputable def universalMulSourceBaseChangeEquiv
    73	    (K : Type u) [CommRing K] [Algebra RZ K] :
    74	    K ⊗[RZ] universalMulSource C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j ≃ₗ[K]
    75	      Fin (Module.finrank k HS) → (K ⊗[RZ] K₁) :=
    76	  TensorProduct.piRight RZ K K (fun _ : Fin (Module.finrank k HS) => K₁)

# SPEC DD-4 REDESIGN — the relative-achiever / relative-BPF feasibility verdict (2026-07-20, DESIGN lane)

Settles THE decisive feasibility question of the representability campaign: can the
DD-4 relative-achiever / relative-BPF seam be built, so that the G-4 seed's `hdvd`
(hence `divRep`) closes? Reads I-0288 (the current-construction inadequacy proof — the
"read first" note), I-0287/0284/0281 (the seed-close reductions), I-0272 (why Route-2
routed through the seed), I-0268/0264/0260/0258 (the achiever-lift history), I-0247
(the fibre-divisor keystone), I-0240 (SlicingFlatKernel), I-0244/0285 (SupportTube /
no-leak). Supersedes `informal/spec-dd4-seam.md` (I-0268): that worksheet's Route 2
was correct in spirit but its `relDivisor := seedUniv.localEquations` realization routed
through the seed's `dvd` (I-0272), so it did not dissolve the wall. This note carries the
construction the whole way. All `file:line` are verbatim spot-checks this pass.

## §0. Verdict box (read this first)

> **VERDICT: HARD-BUT-BUILDABLE.** The seam is SOUND and unblockable; there is NO
> impossibility. The recurring achiever-lift obstruction (I-0258) is **dissolved** — not by
> skipping the seed, but by lifting through a **surjection** instead of a rigid reduction.
> The essential content is one honest brick — **relative-local base-point-freeness by
> stalk-Nakayama** — sitting on the (landed-scoped) carve flat-rank-`g` engine. Realistic
> cost: **multi-week, ≈ 2 XL + 3 L + 2 M bricks** (§3). Not a bounded single-session win;
> not blocked.
>
> **RECOMMENDED ROUTE — keep the seed; redesign `(sec z, h z)` by surjection-lift +
> Nakayama-neighbourhood.** Consume the LANDED seed finale
> (`isGenerator_of_fibre_ne_zero`, `DivSchemeSeed.lean:188`; `divFamEps_certifiedFamily`,
> `DivSchemeEps.lean:312`) VERBATIM. The two pointwise fields I-0288 condemned become:
> * **(A) `sec z` — a relative achiever AT `z`**, built by lifting a κ(p)-fibre achiever
>   through the **surjection** `read ⊗ κ(p) : K_univ ⊗ κ(p) ↠ H⁰(N − d_p)`
>   (`divUniversalFibreKM_eq_span`, `DivSchemeSeedUnivRes.lean:376`) — NOT by reducing a
>   window vector to a chosen `f_p`. I-0258's "single window vector need not reduce to a
>   chosen κ(p)-combination" is TRUE but IRRELEVANT: we need SOME achiever at `z`, and the
>   surjection hits every element of `H⁰(N − d_p)`, achievers included. This is a clean
>   lift, not the "non-liftable" step the history feared.
> * **(B) `h z` — a genuine fibre-cutter `h z ∈ ann(N z)`**, `N z := J / (read sec z)`
>   (`J` = the base ideal `⟨K_univ readings⟩`), produced by `SupportTubeFinite` (`N z`
>   finite over `R_Z`, I-0244) at the point `z ∉ supp(N z)`. `ann(N z)` elements are
>   HONEST fibre-cutting sections — the missing "cut in the fibre, not the base" that
>   `algebraMap f` (`DivSchemeSeedUnivGen.lean:289`) could never provide (I-0288 fact 2).
>   `D(h z)` shrinks in the fibre to exactly the locus where `read sec z` achieves `d`, so

   126	This is the single remaining wall of the divisor-first `hdvd`, isolated to the carve's own
   127	fibre geometry. -/
   128	theorem dvd_of_flat_quotient_of_field_vanishing [IsNoetherianRing R]
   129	    (hreg : ∀ (z : relCurve C R) (y : relCurve C R) (hy : y ∈ D.piece z),
   130	      ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (D.piece z) y hy).hom (D.eqn z)
   131	        ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C R).presheaf.stalk y))
   132	    (hfin : ∀ z : relCurve C R, Module.Finite R (D.sideColengthSubmodule z))
   133	    (hflat : ∀ z : relCurve C R,
   134	      Module.Flat R ((Γ(relCurve C R, D.piece z) ⧸ Ideal.span {D.eqn z})
   135	        ⧸ D.sideColengthSubmodule z))
   136	    (hfield : ∀ (z : relCurve C R) (y : relCurve C R) (hy : y ∈ D.piece z)
   137	        (x : ↥(D.sideColengthSubmodule z)),
   138	        ((x : Γ(relCurve C R, D.piece z) ⧸ Ideal.span {D.eqn z}) ⊗ₜ[R]
   139	            (1 : (basePrime (R := R)
   140	              ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (D.piece z) y hy).hom).asIdeal.ResidueField))
   141	          = 0) :
   142	    ∀ (z : relCurve C R) ⦃ψ : relThetaSections C R π a⦄, ψ ∈ K →
   143	      relThetaResSide a (D.side z) (D.piece_le z) ψ ∈ Ideal.span {D.eqn z} :=
   144	  D.dvd_of_forall_subsingleton_tmul_residueField hreg hfin (fun z y hy => by
   145	    haveI := hflat z
   146	    exact _root_.subsingleton_tmul_residueField_of_flat_quotient (D.sideColengthSubmodule z)
   147	      (basePrime (R := R) ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (D.piece z) y hy).hom)
   148	      (fun x => hfield z y hy x))
   149	
   150	set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
   151	-- deriving the colength `IsNoetherian`/`Module.Finite` instances re-elaborates the heavy
   152	-- relCurve section-ring quotient type past the default budget (as in
   153	-- `sideColengthSubmodule_finite`)
   154	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000 in
   155	/-- **The `hdvd` wall, fibre-kernel form** (the sharpened single obligation, replacing the
   156	per-point flat-quotient input of `dvd_of_flat_quotient_of_field_vanishing` by the more
   157	primitive fibrewise-kernel data): the seed satisfies its divisibility clause given
   158	
   159	* `hcolFin`/`hcolFlat` — each colength `Γ(D(h z)) ⧸ (eqn z)` is **finite and flat** over
   160	  `R` (the slicing criterion
   161	  `Module.Flat.quotient_span_singleton_of_forall_tmul_residueField` from the seed's
   162	  fibre-regularity + the `SupportTube` finiteness — both landed, per piece);
   163	* `hspan` — **the fibrewise-kernel-spanning law**: at every base prime `p` the fibre
   164	  kernel of the `K`-side-component map `K → Γ(D(h z)) ⧸ (eqn z)` is spanned by the base
   165	  change of its global kernel (the fibrewise carve `divUniversal_carve_residueField`;
   166	  exactly the certificate-clause-(c4) input);
   167	* `hfield` — every `K`-side component dies in the ambient residue-field fibre
   168	  (`x ⊗ₜ 1 = 0`), i.e. is divisible by the fibre equation `e_p` (the `d_p` achiever
   169	  `exists_coeffAt_eq_baseDivisorAt`, transported by `pieceQuotBaseChangeAlg`).
   170	
   171	`hspan` (with `K` finite and the colength finite/flat) yields the per-point flatness of
   172	`(Γ(D(h z)) ⧸ (eqn z)) ⧸ N z` through the flattening keystone (c4)
   173	`Module.Flat.quotient_range_of_forall_ker_rTensor_residueField_le` — `N z` is the range of
   174	the `K`-side-component map — and that flatness plus `hfield` is exactly the input of
   175	`dvd_of_flat_quotient_of_field_vanishing`.  This isolates the divisor-first `hdvd` to the
   176	single fibrewise-kernel obligation `hspan`: **no glued↔per-point flatness bridge**, and,
   177	contra the module-fibre "supply `hfib` directly" route, the flatness the `k[ε]` trap
   178	demands (needed to turn `hfield` into `Subsingleton (N z ⊗ κ(p))`) is supplied here by
   179	`hspan` + `hcolFlat`, never by `hfield` alone. -/
   180	theorem dvd_of_fibrewise_ker_span_of_field_vanishing [IsNoetherianRing R]
   181	    [Module.Finite R ↥K]
   182	    (hreg : ∀ (z : relCurve C R) (y : relCurve C R) (hy : y ∈ D.piece z),
   183	      ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (D.piece z) y hy).hom (D.eqn z)
   184	        ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C R).presheaf.stalk y))
   185	    (hcolFin : ∀ z : relCurve C R,
   186	      Module.Finite R (Γ(relCurve C R, D.piece z) ⧸ Ideal.span {D.eqn z}))
   187	    (hcolFlat : ∀ z : relCurve C R,
   188	      Module.Flat R (Γ(relCurve C R, D.piece z) ⧸ Ideal.span {D.eqn z}))
   189	    (hspan : ∀ (z : relCurve C R) (p : PrimeSpectrum R),
   190	      LinearMap.ker (((D.kColengthMap z).comp K.subtype).rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField)
   191	        ≤ LinearMap.range
   192	          ((LinearMap.ker ((D.kColengthMap z).comp K.subtype)).subtype.rTensor
   193	            p.asIdeal.ResidueField))
   194	    (hfield : ∀ (z : relCurve C R) (y : relCurve C R) (hy : y ∈ D.piece z)
   195	        (x : ↥(D.sideColengthSubmodule z)),
   196	        ((x : Γ(relCurve C R, D.piece z) ⧸ Ideal.span {D.eqn z}) ⊗ₜ[R]
   197	            (1 : (basePrime (R := R)
   198	              ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (D.piece z) y hy).hom).asIdeal.ResidueField))
   199	          = 0) :
   200	    ∀ (z : relCurve C R) ⦃ψ : relThetaSections C R π a⦄, ψ ∈ K →
   201	      relThetaResSide a (D.side z) (D.piece_le z) ψ ∈ Ideal.span {D.eqn z} := by
   202	  refine D.dvd_of_flat_quotient_of_field_vanishing hreg
   203	    (fun z => by haveI := hcolFin z; exact D.sideColengthSubmodule_finite z)
   204	    (fun z => ?_) hfield
   205	  haveI := hcolFin z
   206	  haveI := hcolFlat z
   207	  have hrange : D.sideColengthSubmodule z
   208	      = LinearMap.range ((D.kColengthMap z).comp K.subtype) := by
   209	    rw [LinearMap.range_comp, Submodule.range_subtype]; rfl
   210	  rw [hrange]
   211	  exact Module.Flat.quotient_range_of_forall_ker_rTensor_residueField_le
   212	    ((D.kColengthMap z).comp K.subtype)
   213	    (LinearMap.ker ((D.kColengthMap z).comp K.subtype)) le_rfl (hspan z)
   214	
   215	end ThetaGeneratorSeed
   216	
   217	end AlgebraicGeometry

     8	/-!
     9	# DD-4 — the seed section is a fibre kernel witness of the `K`-side-component map
    10	
    11	For any theta generator seed `D` the candidate generator `sec z` lies in `K` (`sec_mem`)
    12	and its side component **is** the equation `eqn z`, so its class in the colength
    13	`Γ(D(h z)) ⧸ (eqn z)` is zero: `kColengthMap z (sec z) = 0`.  Hence `sec z` is a nonzero
    14	element of `K` (nonzero in the fibre by the seed construction) that is killed by
    15	`f_z := kColengthMap z ∘ K.subtype`.
    16	
    17	This is the structural witness that `f_z` is **never fibrewise injective** when `sec z`
    18	survives fibrewise — i.e. `ThetaGeneratorSeed.FibreInjective z` is *false* for any seed
    19	whose seed section has nonzero residue-field fibre.  See the landing note (SEED CLOSE:
    20	`FibreInjective` route is unsound; the correct route is
    21	`dvd_of_fibrewise_ker_span_of_field_vanishing`, the `hspan`/`c4` keystone).
    22	-/
    23	
    24	set_option autoImplicit false
    25	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    26	
    27	universe u
    28	
    29	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite
    30	open scoped TensorProduct
    31	
    32	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    33	
    34	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    35	
    36	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    37	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
    38	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π] {a : ℕ}
    39	variable {K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)}
    40	
    41	namespace ThetaGeneratorSeed
    42	
    43	variable (D : ThetaGeneratorSeed C R π a K)
    44	
    45	/-- **The seed section lies in the fibre kernel of the `K`-side-component map**: its side
    46	component is by definition the equation `eqn z`, so its colength class vanishes,
    47	`kColengthMap z (sec z) = 0`.  Combined with `sec_mem` (`sec z ∈ K`) this exhibits a
    48	distinguished element of `K` that `f_z = kColengthMap z ∘ K.subtype` always kills — the
    49	obstruction to fibrewise injectivity of `f_z` whenever `sec z` survives in the fibre. -/
    50	@[simp]
    51	theorem kColengthMap_sec_eq_zero (z : relCurve C R) :
    52	    D.kColengthMap z (D.sec z) = 0 := by
    53	  change Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {D.eqn z})
    54	      (relThetaResSide a (D.side z) (D.piece_le z) (D.sec z)) = 0
    55	  exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
    56	    (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self (D.eqn z))
    57

    59	The class of `⟨sec z, sec_mem z⟩` under `f_z` is `kColengthMap z (sec z) = 0`. -/
    60	theorem sec_mem_ker_kColengthMap_comp_subtype (z : relCurve C R) :
    61	    (⟨D.sec z, D.sec_mem z⟩ : ↥K) ∈
    62	      LinearMap.ker ((D.kColengthMap z).comp K.subtype) := by
    63	  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply]
    64	  exact D.kColengthMap_sec_eq_zero z
    65	
    66	/-- **`IsGenerator` on the sound `hspan` (`c4`) route** — the correct seed-close assembly
    67	(replacing the *unsound* `FibreInjective` route: `f_z = kColengthMap z ∘ K.subtype`
    68	kills the fibre-nonzero section `sec z ∈ K`, so `f_z ⊗ κ(p)` is never injective and
    69	`FibreInjective z` is false).  Composes the sharpened divisibility capstone
    70	`dvd_of_fibrewise_ker_span_of_field_vanishing` (`Picard/DivSchemeSeedDvd.lean:180`, the
    71	`hspan`/`c4` `Module.Flat.quotient_range_of_forall_ker_rTensor_residueField_le` route)
    72	with the fibre-regularity discharge `isGenerator_of_fibre_ne_zero`
    73	(`Picard/DivSchemeSeed.lean:188`).  Reduces the whole DDR-3 close of the seed to the six
    74	route-independent fibre facts:
    75	
    76	* `hreg` — germ regularity of the equation (fibre-regularity law);
    77	* `hcolFin`/`hcolFlat` — each colength `Γ(D(h z)) ⧸ (eqn z)` finite/flat over `R`;
    78	* `hspan` — the fibre kernel of the `K`-side-component map is spanned by the base change
    79	  of its global kernel (the genuine carve flat rank-`g` content, the `c4` clause);
    80	* `hfield` — every `K`-side component dies in the ambient residue-field fibre;
    81	* `hfib` — the compared chart component of the seed section is fibrewise nonzero.
    82	
    83	`D.localEquations (this)` is then the DDR-3 `relDivisor`. -/
    84	theorem isGenerator_of_fibrewise_ker_span_of_field_vanishing [IsNoetherianRing R]
    85	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    86	    [Module.Finite R ↥K]
    87	    (hreg : ∀ (z : relCurve C R) (y : relCurve C R) (hy : y ∈ D.piece z),
    88	      ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (D.piece z) y hy).hom (D.eqn z)
    89	        ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C R).presheaf.stalk y))
    90	    (hcolFin : ∀ z : relCurve C R,
    91	      Module.Finite R (Γ(relCurve C R, D.piece z) ⧸ Ideal.span {D.eqn z}))
    92	    (hcolFlat : ∀ z : relCurve C R,
    93	      Module.Flat R (Γ(relCurve C R, D.piece z) ⧸ Ideal.span {D.eqn z}))
    94	    (hspan : ∀ (z : relCurve C R) (p : PrimeSpectrum R),
    95	      LinearMap.ker (((D.kColengthMap z).comp K.subtype).rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField)
    96	        ≤ LinearMap.range
    97	          ((LinearMap.ker ((D.kColengthMap z).comp K.subtype)).subtype.rTensor
    98	            p.asIdeal.ResidueField))
    99	    (hfield : ∀ (z : relCurve C R) (y : relCurve C R) (hy : y ∈ D.piece z)
   100	        (x : ↥(D.sideColengthSubmodule z)),
   101	        ((x : Γ(relCurve C R, D.piece z) ⧸ Ideal.span {D.eqn z}) ⊗ₜ[R]
   102	            (1 : (basePrime (R := R)
   103	              ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (D.piece z) y hy).hom).asIdeal.ResidueField))
   104	          = 0)
   105	    (hfib : ∀ (z : relCurve C R) (p : PrimeSpectrum R),
   106	      ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).basicOpen
   107	          (relPinnedSectionsMap C R p.asIdeal.ResidueField π (D.side z) (D.h z)) :
   108	        (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).Opens) ≠ ⊥ →
   109	      relPinnedSectionsMap C R p.asIdeal.ResidueField π (D.side z)
   110	        (relThetaResSide a (D.side z) le_rfl (D.sec z)) ≠ 0) :
   111	    D.IsGenerator :=
   112	  D.isGenerator_of_fibre_ne_zero
   113	    (D.dvd_of_fibrewise_ker_span_of_field_vanishing hreg hcolFin hcolFlat hspan hfield)
   114	    hfib
   115	
   116	end ThetaGeneratorSeed

     9	/-!
    10	# DD-4 — the submodule germ bridge: chart reading ↔ function-field reading
    11	
    12	Upgrades the germ **divisibility** bridge `germ_relThetaResSide_dvd_iff_ord_le`
    13	(`DivSchemeUnivFibreHdiv.lean`, `15d9eb465`) to a `K`-**linear submodule** identification,
    14	over the fibre curve `relCurve C K` at *any* field extension `K/k`.  No residue-field
    15	`κ(p)` tower is needed at this level — that enters only when the identification is
    16	base-changed inside the carve pin (steps 2–3), so the whole bridge is built over a general
    17	field `K` and stays outside the `κ(p)` instance minefield.
    18	
    19	The reading of a pinned-chart section into the function field is mathlib's
    20	`Scheme.germGenericLinear K hη` (`s ↦ germ_η s`, `K`-linear).  Composed with the
    21	side-uniform chart component `relThetaResSide a b le_rfl`, it agrees — up to a **fixed**
    22	unit `u` of the function field (the chart-transition unit; the trivializing element of the
    23	theta presentation is `1` at the generic point) — with the function-field reading
    24	`thetaFieldRead`:
    25	
    26	* `exists_unit_germGenericLinear_relThetaResSide_eq` — the pointwise identity
    27	  `germ_η (relThetaResSide a b _ s) = u · thetaFieldRead s`, the reading identification;
    28	* `exists_unit_germGenericLinear_comp_relThetaResSide` — its `LinearMap` form;
    29	* `exists_unit_map_germGenericLinear_range_chartReadMap` — **the submodule bridge**: the
    30	  chart base-ideal range `N_V = range (chartReadMap W b)`, read into the function field, is
    31	  the unit multiple `u · thetaFieldRead(W)` of the function-field reading of `W`.  This is
    32	  the `κ`-linear submodule identification the carve pin consumes (via
    33	  `divUniversalFibreKM_eq_span`), replacing the earlier divisibility-only bridge.
    34	-/
    35	
    36	set_option autoImplicit false
    37	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    38	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    39	
    40	universe u
    41	
    42	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite
    43	open scoped TensorProduct
    44	
    45	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    46	
    47	open Scheme
    48	
    49	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    50	  Scheme.functionFieldOverModule
    51	
    52	namespace ThetaGeneratorSeed
    53	
    54	section ReadingBridge
    55	
    56	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    57	variable (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    58	variable (π : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite π]
    59	variable (a : ℕ)
    60	variable [IsIntegral (relCurve C K)]
    61	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    62	  [QuasiCompact (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    63	
    64	/-- **The reading identification, pointwise**: on the fibre curve `relCurve C K`, the germ
    65	at the generic point `η` of the side component `relThetaResSide a b hV s` (the reading of a
    66	theta section into the pinned chart `Γ(V)`, read on into the function field via
    67	`germGenericLinear`) equals a **fixed** function-field unit `u` — independent of `s` — times
    68	the function-field reading `thetaFieldRead s`.  The unit `u` is the chart-transition unit of
    69	`exists_unit_germ_relThetaResSide_eq`; the trivializing element `elem η` is `1` at `η`
    70	(`thetaFieldPresentation_elem_genericPoint`), so it drops out.  This is the equality upgrade
    71	of the divisibility bridge `germ_relThetaResSide_dvd_iff_ord_le`. -/
    72	theorem exists_unit_germGenericLinear_relThetaResSide_eq (b : Bool)
    73	    {V : (relCurve C K).Opens} (hV : V ≤ relPinnedChart C K π b)
    74	    (hηV : genericPoint (relCurve C K) ∈ V) :
    75	    ∃ u : (relCurve C K).functionFieldˣ, ∀ (s : relThetaSections C K π a),
    76	      Scheme.germGenericLinear K hηV (relThetaResSide a b hV s)
    77	        = (u : (relCurve C K).functionField) * thetaFieldRead C K π a s := by
    78	  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_unit_germ_relThetaResSide_eq C K π a b hV hηV
    79	  refine ⟨w, fun s => ?_⟩
    80	  have hgl : ((relCurve C K).presheaf.germ
    81	        (⊤ ⊓ (thetaFieldPointedCover C K π).opens (genericPoint (relCurve C K)))
    82	        (genericPoint (relCurve C K))
    83	        ⟨trivial, (thetaFieldPointedCover C K π).mem_opens (genericPoint (relCurve C K))⟩).hom
    84	        ((thetaFieldGluedEquiv C K π a s).val (genericPoint (relCurve C K)))
    85	      = thetaFieldRead C K π a s := by
    86	    rw [germ_generic_eq_algebraMap_germ
    87	        (⟨trivial, (thetaFieldPointedCover C K π).mem_opens (genericPoint (relCurve C K))⟩ :
    88	          genericPoint (relCurve C K)
    89	            ∈ ⊤ ⊓ (thetaFieldPointedCover C K π).opens (genericPoint (relCurve C K)))
    90	        (⟨trivial, (thetaFieldPointedCover C K π).mem_opens (genericPoint (relCurve C K))⟩ :
    91	          genericPoint (relCurve C K)
    92	            ∈ ⊤ ⊓ (thetaFieldPointedCover C K π).opens (genericPoint (relCurve C K))),
    93	      algebraMap_germ_thetaFieldGluedEquiv_eq C K π a s (genericPoint (relCurve C K)),
    94	      thetaFieldPresentation_elem_genericPoint, Units.val_one, one_mul]
    95	  change ((relCurve C K).presheaf.germ V (genericPoint (relCurve C K)) hηV).hom
    96	      (relThetaResSide a b hV s) = _
    97	  rw [hw s, hgl]
    98	
    99	/-- **The reading identification, `LinearMap` form**: the composite reading
   100	`germGenericLinear K hη ∘ relThetaResSide a b le_rfl : relThetaSections → functionField`
   101	is `u · thetaFieldRead` (multiplication by a fixed function-field unit), as `K`-linear
   102	maps. -/
   103	theorem exists_unit_germGenericLinear_comp_relThetaResSide (b : Bool)
   104	    (hηV : genericPoint (relCurve C K) ∈ relPinnedChart C K π b) :
   105	    ∃ u : (relCurve C K).functionFieldˣ,
   106	      (Scheme.germGenericLinear K hηV).comp (relThetaResSide a b le_rfl)
   107	        = (Scheme.mulLinear K (u : (relCurve C K).functionField)).comp
   108	            (thetaFieldRead C K π a) := by
   109	  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ :=
   110	    exists_unit_germGenericLinear_relThetaResSide_eq C K π a b le_rfl hηV
   111	  refine ⟨u, LinearMap.ext fun s => ?_⟩
   112	  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Scheme.mulLinear_apply]
   113	  exact hu s
   114	
   115	/-- **The submodule germ bridge** (the `κ`-linear submodule identification): the range of
   116	the chart reading map `chartReadMap W b` — the chart base ideal `N_V = ⟨relThetaResSide b ψ :
   117	ψ ∈ W⟩ ⊆ Γ(V)` — read into the function field by `germGenericLinear`, is the unit multiple
   118	`u · thetaFieldRead(W)` of the function-field reading of `W`.  Over the fibre curve
   119	`relCurve C K` at any field `K`, this identifies the two `K`-subspaces (the chart-section
   120	reading and the function-field reading) up to a fixed function-field unit — the equality
   121	upgrade, at the submodule level, of the divisibility bridge
   122	`germ_relThetaResSide_dvd_iff_ord_le`.  Combined with `divUniversalFibreKM_eq_span` it feeds
   123	the carve pin. -/
   124	theorem exists_unit_map_germGenericLinear_range_chartReadMap (b : Bool)
   125	    (hηV : genericPoint (relCurve C K) ∈ relPinnedChart C K π b)
   126	    (W : Submodule K (relThetaSections C K π a)) :
   127	    ∃ u : (relCurve C K).functionFieldˣ,
   128	      Submodule.map (Scheme.germGenericLinear K hηV)
   129	          (LinearMap.range (chartReadMap W b))
   130	        = Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear K (u : (relCurve C K).functionField))
   131	            (Submodule.map (thetaFieldRead C K π a) W) := by

/-! ## The side-uniform piece comparison and colength transport -/

/-- **The side-uniform piece-sections comparison**: the base-change section map on the
basic open `D(h)` of a pinned chart, cased over the side `b`
(`pieceSectionsMap` at `fiberChart₀`/`fiberChart₁`).  Its target is the piece of the
base-changed generator `relPinnedSectionsMap b h`. -/
noncomputable def pinnedPieceSectionsMap (b : Bool)
    (h : Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b)) :
    Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h) →+*
      Γ(relCurve C R', (relCurve C R').basicOpen (relPinnedSectionsMap C R R' π b h)) :=
  match b, h with
  | false, h => pieceSectionsMap R' (fiberChart₀ π) h
  | true, h => pieceSectionsMap R' (fiberChart₁ π) h

/-- **The side-uniform piece-colength transport**: for a set `E` of equations on `D(h)`,
`R' ⊗[R] (Γ(D(h)) ⧸ (E)) ≃ₐ[R'] Γ(D(h')) ⧸ (pinnedPieceSectionsMap '' E)`, `h' =
relPinnedSectionsMap b h` — the generic `pieceQuotBaseChangeAlg`, cased over the side. -/
noncomputable def pinnedPieceQuotBaseChangeAlg (b : Bool)
    (h : Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b))
    (E : Set Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h)) :
    R' ⊗[R] (Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h) ⧸ Ideal.span E) ≃ₐ[R']
      Γ(relCurve C R', (relCurve C R').basicOpen (relPinnedSectionsMap C R R' π b h)) ⧸
        Ideal.span (pinnedPieceSectionsMap R' b h '' E) :=
  match b, h with
  | false, h =>
      pieceQuotBaseChangeAlg R' (fiberChart₀ π)
        (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₀.isCompact
        (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₀.isQuasiSeparated
        (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R (fiberTwoCover π))
        (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R' (fiberTwoCover π)) h E
  | true, h =>
      pieceQuotBaseChangeAlg R' (fiberChart₁ π)
        (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₁.isCompact
        (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₁.isQuasiSeparated
        (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R (fiberTwoCover π))
        (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R' (fiberTwoCover π)) h E

/-- The colength transport on a pure tensor of a residue class:
`1 ⊗ [s] ↦ [pinnedPieceSectionsMap s]`. -/
lemma pinnedPieceQuotBaseChangeAlg_one_tmul_mk (b : Bool)
    (h : Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b))
    (E : Set Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h))
    (s : Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h)) :
    pinnedPieceQuotBaseChangeAlg R' b h E
        ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span E) s) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (pinnedPieceSectionsMap R' b h '' E))
        (pinnedPieceSectionsMap R' b h s) := by
  cases b with
  | false =>
      exact pieceQuotBaseChangeAlg_one_tmul_mk R' (fiberChart₀ π)
        (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₀.isCompact
        (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₀.isQuasiSeparated
        (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R (fiberTwoCover π))
        (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R' (fiberTwoCover π)) h E s
  | true =>
      exact pieceQuotBaseChangeAlg_one_tmul_mk R' (fiberChart₁ π)
        (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₁.isCompact
        (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₁.isQuasiSeparated
        (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R (fiberTwoCover π))
        (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R' (fiberTwoCover π)) h E s

/-- **The transported fibre-vanishing clause**: the residue class `[s]` of a piece section
dies in the fibre `κ(p)` (`[s] ⊗ₜ 1 = 0`) iff its image `pinnedPieceSectionsMap s` in the
base-changed piece lies in the ideal generated by the transported equations
`pinnedPieceSectionsMap '' E` — the exact reduction of `hfield` (and of the `hspan` fibre
kernel comparison) to fibre divisibility on the base-changed curve. -/
lemma mk_tmul_one_eq_zero_iff_pinnedPieceSectionsMap_mem (b : Bool)
    (h : Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b))
    (E : Set Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h))
    (s : Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h)) :
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span E) s ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : R')
        : (Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h) ⧸ Ideal.span E) ⊗[R] R') = 0
      ↔ pinnedPieceSectionsMap R' b h s
          ∈ Ideal.span (pinnedPieceSectionsMap R' b h '' E) := by
  rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem,
    ← pinnedPieceQuotBaseChangeAlg_one_tmul_mk R' b h E s,
    map_eq_zero_iff _ (pinnedPieceQuotBaseChangeAlg R' b h E).injective,
    ← LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff (TensorProduct.comm R _ R'), TensorProduct.comm_tmul]

# DDR-8 — the window→stalk-ideal bridge (the `hbridge` seam, window-recovery route)

This file discharges the *upgrade machinery* of the `hbridge` seam of
`Picard/DivSchemeMono.lean`: equal `ε`-windows over the test ring `R` force equal stalk
ideals at every point of `relCurve C R`, hence `DivEq` (`divFam_divEq_of_eps_eq'`).

## Route correction (binding for the follow-up lane)

The route sketched in the `DivSchemeMono` header — *fibrewise stalk-ideal equality (the
field mono at every `κ(p)`) upgraded to relative stalk-ideal equality by the colon-Tor
pair* — is **mathematically incomplete**: fibrewise stalk-ideal equality does NOT imply
relative equality.  Witness (`R = k[ε]`, affine chart of a curve): the divisors cut by
`t` and `t + ε` have *equal stalk ideals in every residue-field fibre* (both cut `(t)`
over `κ((ε)) = k`), both colengths are free `R`-modules of rank one, yet
`(t) ≠ (t + ε)` in `k[ε][t]_{(t,ε)}` — because `t + ε = c·t` forces `ε ∈ t·k[ε][t]`
locally, which fails.  The relative information that separates them is exactly the
`ε`-window over `R` (their vanishing submodules in `R ⊗ H_M` differ).  Any honest
discharge must therefore consume the window equality at the `R`-level, not only
fibrewise.

## The window-recovery route (this file)

Per certified family the stalk ideal is *recovered from the window*: at every point `z`
the germs of the window sections generate the stalk ideal.  Since the window is shared
(`heps`), the two stalk ideals coincide — the field mono at `κ(p)` is not needed at all.

* **§1** `Scheme.twistGermSet` — the germs at `z` of the chart components of a set of
  twisted pairs; `span_twistGermSet_le_stalkIdeal` — germs of vanishing sections lie in
  the stalk ideal (the easy inclusion).
* **§2** the local upgrade (pure algebra, no scheme, no Noetherian hypothesis):
  - `mul_mem_smul_top_of_flat_coker_of_mem_smul_top` — over a flat colength `B ⧸ (f)`
    the regular element `f` cancels from `s`-multiples (`f·x ∈ s•B ⟹ x ∈ s•B`); the
    `R' = R⧸s` instance of the Kleiman `lm:ctn` (i)⟹(iii) discharge
    (`includeRight_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_flat_coker`).
  - `span_singleton_algebraMap_eq_of_le_sup_map` — **the unit trick** at a localization
    `L` of `B` at a prime: if `(f) ⊆ E + s·L` with `E ⊆ (f)` and `s` mapping into the
    maximal ideal, then `(f) = E` — write `f = e + c·f`, cancel `f` from `c·f ∈ s·L`
    through the flat colength (clearing denominators), so `c ∈ s·L ⊆ m_L` and `1 − c`
    is a unit.
* **§3** the geometric instantiation on a certified adaptation:
  `DivisorAdaptation.stalkIdeal_eq_span_germ_eqn` (piece equations generate, over any
  test ring — the `R`-generic port of the field-level lemma) and
  `DivisorAdaptation.stalkIdeal_eq_of_le_sup_map` — the certificate clause (c1)
  `projective_colength` is exactly the flat-colength input, and the stalk is the
  localization of the piece ring (`IsAffineOpen.isLocalization_stalk`).
* **§4** the family keystones: `divFamEpsWindowGermSet` (the germ set of the
  `ε`-window), `CertifiedDivisorFamily.stalkIdeal_eq_span_windowGerm` (the per-family
  recovery), `divFam_stalkIdeal_eq_of_eps_eq` (the discharged `hbridge` shape), and the
  pinned `divFam_divEq_of_eps_eq'`.

## The one named seam (`hwin`)

What remains gated is the **window generation input** `hwin`: at every `z` (with base
ideal `s` mapping into `m_z`), the stalk ideal is generated by window germs *modulo*
`s` — `I_d(z) ≤ ⟨window germs⟩ ⊔ s·𝒪_z`.  This is fibre-level content: at the residue
field `κ(s)` it is base-point-freeness of the window `H⁰(𝒪(N − D))` (the achiever

/-! ## §1 The germ set of a set of twisted pairs -/

section GermSet

variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of A))]
variable {V₀ V₁ : X.Opens} {gc : Γ(X, V₀ ⊓ V₁)ˣ}

/-- **The germ set of a set of twisted pairs at a point**: the germs at `z` of the chart
components of the members of `T`, on whichever pinned chart(s) contain `z`.  For
`T = ` (the image of) a divisor-family window this is the set whose span the DDR-8
bridge shows to be the full stalk ideal. -/
def Scheme.twistGermSet (T : Set ↥(twistSubmodule A V₀ V₁ gc ⊤)) (z : X) :
    Set (X.presheaf.stalk z) :=
  {a | ∃ (x : ↥(twistSubmodule A V₀ V₁ gc ⊤)) (_ : x ∈ T) (hz₀ : z ∈ ⊤ ⊓ V₀),
      a = (X.presheaf.germ (⊤ ⊓ V₀) z hz₀).hom x.val.1} ∪
  {a | ∃ (x : ↥(twistSubmodule A V₀ V₁ gc ⊤)) (_ : x ∈ T) (hz₁ : z ∈ ⊤ ⊓ V₁),
      a = (X.presheaf.germ (⊤ ⊓ V₁) z hz₁).hom x.val.2}

/-- **The easy inclusion**: germs of vanishing sections lie in the stalk ideal — the
membership clauses of `vanishingSubmodule` verbatim. -/
lemma span_twistGermSet_le_stalkIdeal (d : X.LocalEquations)
    {T : Set ↥(twistSubmodule A V₀ V₁ gc ⊤)}
    (hT : T ⊆ ↑(d.vanishingSubmodule A V₀ V₁ gc)) (z : X) :
    Ideal.span (Scheme.twistGermSet T z) ≤ d.stalkIdeal z := by
  rw [Ideal.span_le]
  rintro a (⟨x, hx, hz₀, rfl⟩ | ⟨x, hx, hz₁, rfl⟩)
  · exact ((Scheme.LocalEquations.mem_vanishingSubmodule_iff A).mp (hT hx)).1 z hz₀
  · exact ((Scheme.LocalEquations.mem_vanishingSubmodule_iff A).mp (hT hx)).2 z hz₁

end GermSet

/-! ## §2 The local upgrade: cancelling a flat-colength regular element -/

section LocalBridge

variable {R B : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]

/-- **Cancelling a regular element with flat colength from `s`-multiples**
(the `R⧸s`-instance of the Kleiman `lm:ctn` (i)⟹(iii) discharge
`includeRight_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_flat_coker`): if `f` is a nonzerodivisor of the
`R`-algebra `B` whose colength `B ⧸ (f)` is `R`-flat, then for every ideal `s` of `R`,
`f · x ∈ s • B` forces `x ∈ s • B`.  No Noetherian hypothesis. -/
theorem mul_mem_smul_top_of_flat_coker_of_mem_smul_top
    {f : B} (hf : f ∈ nonZeroDivisors B) [Module.Flat R (B ⧸ Ideal.span {f})]
    (s : Ideal R) {x : B} (h : f * x ∈ s • (⊤ : Submodule R B)) :
    x ∈ s • (⊤ : Submodule R B) := by
  have hreg := Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_flat_coker
    (R := R) (R' := R ⧸ s) f hf
  -- the tensor image of `f * x` vanishes
  have hz : ((1 : R ⧸ s) ⊗ₜ[R] (f * x) : (R ⧸ s) ⊗[R] B) = 0 := by
    apply (TensorProduct.quotTensorEquivQuotSMul B s).injective
    rw [map_zero, TensorProduct.quotTensorEquivQuotSMul_mk_one_tmul,
      Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    exact h
  -- split off the regular factor
  have hsplit : ((1 : R ⧸ s) ⊗ₜ[R] (f * x) : (R ⧸ s) ⊗[R] B)
      = Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight f * ((1 : R ⧸ s) ⊗ₜ[R] x) := by
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul,
      one_mul]
  have hx0 : ((1 : R ⧸ s) ⊗ₜ[R] x : (R ⧸ s) ⊗[R] B) = 0 :=
    (mul_left_mem_nonZeroDivisors_eq_zero_iff hreg).mp (by rw [← hsplit]; exact hz)
  have hmk : (TensorProduct.quotTensorEquivQuotSMul B s) ((1 : R ⧸ s) ⊗ₜ[R] x)
      = (TensorProduct.quotTensorEquivQuotSMul B s) 0 := by rw [hx0]
  rwa [TensorProduct.quotTensorEquivQuotSMul_mk_one_tmul, map_zero,
    Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at hmk

variable {L : Type u} [CommRing L] [Algebra B L] [Algebra R L] [IsScalarTower R B L]

/-- **The unit trick at a localization** (the heart of the DDR-8 window→stalk-ideal
bridge): let `L` be the localization of the `R`-algebra `B` at a prime `q`, `f ∈ B` a
nonzerodivisor with `R`-flat colength `B ⧸ (f)`, and `s` an ideal of `R` mapping into
the maximal ideal of `L`.  If an ideal `E ⊆ (f)` of `L` covers `(f)` modulo `s` —
`(f) ⊆ E ⊔ s·L` — then `E` is all of `(f)`: writing `f = e + c·f`, the cofactor `c`
lies in `s·L` (clear denominators and cancel `f` through the flat colength), hence in
the maximal ideal, so `1 − c` is a unit and `f = (1−c)⁻¹·e ∈ E`. -/
theorem span_singleton_algebraMap_eq_of_le_sup_map [IsLocalRing L]
    (q : Ideal B) [q.IsPrime] [IsLocalization.AtPrime L q]
    {f : B} (hf : f ∈ nonZeroDivisors B) [Module.Flat R (B ⧸ Ideal.span {f})]
    {s : Ideal R} (hs : ∀ r ∈ s, algebraMap R L r ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal L)
    {E : Ideal L} (hE : E ≤ Ideal.span {algebraMap B L f})
    (hcov : Ideal.span {algebraMap B L f} ≤ E ⊔ Ideal.map (algebraMap R L) s) :
    Ideal.span {algebraMap B L f} = E := by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ hE
  -- decompose the generator: `f = e + w` with `w ∈ s·L ∩ (f)`, so `w = c·f`
  obtain ⟨e, he, w, hw, hew⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp
    (hcov (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _))
  have hwa : w ∈ Ideal.span {algebraMap B L f} := by
    have hsub : w = algebraMap B L f - e := by rw [← hew]; ring
    rw [hsub]
    exact Submodule.sub_mem _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _) (hE he)
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hwa
  -- the map ideal through the tower
  have hsB : Ideal.map (algebraMap R L) s
      = Ideal.map (algebraMap B L) (Ideal.map (algebraMap R B) s) := by
    rw [Ideal.map_map, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq]
  -- clear denominators: `f · (c₀·u·v) = t·σ·v ∈ s·B`
  have hcw : c * algebraMap B L f
      ∈ Ideal.map (algebraMap B L) (Ideal.map (algebraMap R B) s) := by
    rw [← hsB, hc]
    exact hw
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨σ, hσ⟩, u⟩, hσu⟩ :=
    (IsLocalization.mem_map_algebraMap_iff q.primeCompl L).mp hcw
  obtain ⟨⟨c₀, t⟩, hct⟩ := IsLocalization.surj q.primeCompl c
  have hkey : algebraMap B L (c₀ * f * ↑u) = algebraMap B L (↑t * σ) := by
    simp only [map_mul]
    rw [← hct, ← hσu]
    ring
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := (IsLocalization.eq_iff_exists q.primeCompl L).mp hkey
  have hfmul : f * (c₀ * ↑u * ↑v) ∈ Ideal.map (algebraMap R B) s := by
    have hre : f * (c₀ * ↑u * ↑v) = ↑v * (c₀ * f * ↑u) := by ring
    rw [hre, hv]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hσ)
  -- cancel `f` through the flat colength
  have hcuv : c₀ * ↑u * ↑v ∈ Ideal.map (algebraMap R B) s := by
    have h1 : f * (c₀ * ↑u * ↑v) ∈ s • (⊤ : Submodule R B) := by
      rw [Ideal.smul_top_eq_map]
      exact hfmul
    have h2 := mul_mem_smul_top_of_flat_coker_of_mem_smul_top hf s h1
    rwa [Ideal.smul_top_eq_map] at h2
  -- descend: `c ∈ s·L`
  have hcmem : c ∈ Ideal.map (algebraMap R L) s := by
    have h3 : c * algebraMap B L (↑t * ↑u * ↑v) = algebraMap B L (c₀ * ↑u * ↑v) := by
      simp only [map_mul]
      rw [← hct]
      ring
    have hunit : IsUnit (algebraMap B L (↑t * ↑u * ↑v : B)) := by
      have hco : (↑t * ↑u * ↑v : B) = ((t * u * v : q.primeCompl) : B) := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [hco]
      exact IsLocalization.map_units L (t * u * v)
    obtain ⟨ω, hω⟩ := hunit
    have hcval : c = algebraMap B L (c₀ * ↑u * ↑v) * ↑ω⁻¹ := by
      rw [← h3, ← hω, mul_assoc, Units.mul_inv, mul_one]
    rw [hcval, hsB]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hcuv)
  have hcmax : c ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal L :=
    (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr fun r hr => Ideal.mem_comap.mpr (hs r hr)) hcmem
  -- the unit trick
  have hunit1c : IsUnit (1 - c) :=
    IsLocalRing.isUnit_one_sub_self_of_mem_nonunits c hcmax
  obtain ⟨ω, hω⟩ := hunit1c
  have hae : ↑ω * algebraMap B L f = e := by
    have hfe : algebraMap B L f - c * algebraMap B L f = e := by
      rw [hc, ← hew]
      ring
    rw [hω, sub_mul, one_mul]
    exact hfe
  rw [Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
  have hfval : algebraMap B L f = ↑ω⁻¹ * e := by
    rw [← hae, ← mul_assoc, Units.inv_mul, one_mul]
  rw [hfval]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ he

end LocalBridge

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}

`DivisorStalkIdeal` private lemma). -/
private lemma span_eq_of_unit_mul {S : Type u} [CommRing S] {a b c : S} (hc : IsUnit c)
    (h : a = c * b) : Ideal.span {a} = Ideal.span {b} := by
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hc
  refine le_antisymm
    (Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton.mpr ⟨u, by rw [h, mul_comm]⟩)
    (Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton.mpr ⟨(↑u⁻¹ : S), ?_⟩)
  rw [h, mul_comm (u : S) b, mul_assoc, Units.mul_inv, mul_one]

/-- **A piece equation generates the stalk ideal at each of its points, over any test
ring** (the `R`-generic port of the field-level
`DivisorAdaptation.span_germ_eqn_eq_stalkIdeal`): the pointwise clause `eqn_rel j z`
presents the germ of `f_j` as a unit germ times the germ of `d`'s equation at the
member of `z` itself, whose span is the stalk ideal. -/
lemma stalkIdeal_eq_span_germ_eqn (j : A.index) {z : relCurve C R}
    (hz : z ∈ A.pieces j) :
    d.stalkIdeal z
      = Ideal.span {((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (A.pieces j) z hz).hom (A.eqn j)} := by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := A.eqn_rel j z
  have hzW : z ∈ A.pieces j ⊓ d.cover.opens z := ⟨hz, d.cover.mem_opens z⟩
  have hgerm := congrArg ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ
    (A.pieces j ⊓ d.cover.opens z) z hzW).hom hu

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]

namespace ThetaGeneratorSeed

variable (D : ThetaGeneratorSeed C R π a K)

set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
-- the colength `Γ(D(h z)) ⧸ (eqn z)` is the heavy relCurve section-ring quotient; deriving
-- the module instances for its quotient by `N z` re-elaborates that type past the default
-- budget (as in `sideColengthSubmodule_finite` / `flat_colength_quotient`)
set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000 in
/-- **Brick 1, single point — the (c4) cokernel flatness from the fibrewise spanning**:
the per-point colength quotient `(Γ(D(h z)) ⧸ (eqn z)) ⧸ N z` is `R`-flat as soon as the
fibrewise-kernel-spanning law `hspan` holds at `z` (plus `K` finite and the colength
finite/flat over `R`).  `N z = sideColengthSubmodule z = range (kColengthMap z ∘ K.subtype)`
is the range of the `K`-side-component reading map, so this is exactly the (c4) keystone
`Module.Flat.quotient_range_of_forall_ker_rTensor_residueField_le` at `L = ker f_z`
(`hle = le_rfl`) — the direct `hflat` producer of the DD-4 capstone
`dvd_of_flat_quotient_of_field_vanishing`, on the *sound* fibrewise-spanning route (never the
false `FibreInjective`). -/
theorem flat_colength_quotient_of_hspan (z : relCurve C R) [Module.Finite R ↥K]
    [Module.Finite R (Γ(relCurve C R, D.piece z) ⧸ Ideal.span {D.eqn z})]
    [Module.Flat R (Γ(relCurve C R, D.piece z) ⧸ Ideal.span {D.eqn z})]
    (hspan : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
      LinearMap.ker (((D.kColengthMap z).comp K.subtype).rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField)
        ≤ LinearMap.range
          ((LinearMap.ker ((D.kColengthMap z).comp K.subtype)).subtype.rTensor
            p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) :
    Module.Flat R ((Γ(relCurve C R, D.piece z) ⧸ Ideal.span {D.eqn z})
      ⧸ D.sideColengthSubmodule z) := by
  have hrange : D.sideColengthSubmodule z
      = LinearMap.range ((D.kColengthMap z).comp K.subtype) := by
    rw [LinearMap.range_comp, Submodule.range_subtype]; rfl
  rw [hrange]
  exact Module.Flat.quotient_range_of_forall_ker_rTensor_residueField_le
    ((D.kColengthMap z).comp K.subtype)
    (LinearMap.ker ((D.kColengthMap z).comp K.subtype)) le_rfl hspan

set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
-- deriving the colength `Module.Finite`/quotient instances re-elaborates the heavy relCurve
-- section-ring quotient type past the default budget (as in `forall_flat_colength_quotient`)
set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000 in
/-- **Brick 1, `∀ z` package — the `hflat` argument from the fibrewise spanning `hspan`**:
from the landed per-piece colength finiteness/flatness (`hcolFin`/`hcolFlat`) and the
fibrewise-kernel-spanning law `hspan` at every point, produces
`∀ z, Module.Flat R ((Γ(D(h z)) ⧸ (eqn z)) ⧸ N z)` — the exact `hflat` argument of
`dvd_of_flat_quotient_of_field_vanishing` and the flat prerequisite (iii) of `RD-N`. -/
theorem forall_flat_colength_quotient_of_hspan [Module.Finite R ↥K]
    (hcolFin : ∀ z : relCurve C R,
      Module.Finite R (Γ(relCurve C R, D.piece z) ⧸ Ideal.span {D.eqn z}))
    (hcolFlat : ∀ z : relCurve C R,
      Module.Flat R (Γ(relCurve C R, D.piece z) ⧸ Ideal.span {D.eqn z}))
    (hspan : ∀ (z : relCurve C R) (p : PrimeSpectrum R),
      LinearMap.ker (((D.kColengthMap z).comp K.subtype).rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField)
        ≤ LinearMap.range
          ((LinearMap.ker ((D.kColengthMap z).comp K.subtype)).subtype.rTensor
            p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) :
    ∀ z : relCurve C R,
      Module.Flat R ((Γ(relCurve C R, D.piece z) ⧸ Ideal.span {D.eqn z})
        ⧸ D.sideColengthSubmodule z) := fun z => by
  haveI := hcolFin z
  haveI := hcolFlat z
  exact D.flat_colength_quotient_of_hspan z (hspan z)

/-- **Brick 1, `∀ z` package from the cleanest carve statement `hsub`**: the same
`hflat` conclusion, reduced all the way to the fibre non-collapse of the side-component
inclusion — at every base prime `p`, `N z ⊗ κ(p) ↪ colength z ⊗ κ(p)` is injective.  This
is the rank-`g` pinning delivered by `divUniversal_carve_residueField`: no fibre of the
`K`-side-component submodule `N z` collapses.  Composes the landed reductions
`hsub ⟹ hinj` (`hinj_of_forall_sideColengthSubmodule_subtype_rTensor_injective`) and
`hinj ⟹ hspan` (`hspan_of_forall_liftQ_rTensor_injective`) with the (c4) keystone; it is the
brick-1 flat producer downstream `RD-N` / the certificate consume, parameterized by the one
honest carve obligation. -/
theorem forall_flat_colength_quotient_of_hsub [Module.Finite R ↥K]
    (hcolFin : ∀ z : relCurve C R,
      Module.Finite R (Γ(relCurve C R, D.piece z) ⧸ Ideal.span {D.eqn z}))
    (hcolFlat : ∀ z : relCurve C R,
      Module.Flat R (Γ(relCurve C R, D.piece z) ⧸ Ideal.span {D.eqn z}))
    (hsub : ∀ (z : relCurve C R) (p : PrimeSpectrum R),
      Function.Injective
        ((D.sideColengthSubmodule z).subtype.rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) :
    ∀ z : relCurve C R,
      Module.Flat R ((Γ(relCurve C R, D.piece z) ⧸ Ideal.span {D.eqn z})
        ⧸ D.sideColengthSubmodule z) :=
  D.forall_flat_colength_quotient_of_hspan hcolFin hcolFlat
    (D.hspan_of_forall_liftQ_rTensor_injective
      (D.hinj_of_forall_sideColengthSubmodule_subtype_rTensor_injective hsub))

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.SlicingFlatKernel
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.SupportTubeFinite

/-! 
# The universal-family certificate assembly

This file assembles the seven fields of `DivisorAdaptation.IsCertified` from the
geometric inputs left by the universal-seed construction:

* finite chart colengths, supplied by the no-leak theorem in `SupportTubeFinite`;
* fibrewise regular chart equations, which make those colengths projective;
* a relative submodule spanning the residue-fibre kernels of the Cech difference map;
* the fibre dimension of that kernel.

The last two inputs feed `SlicingFlatKernel`, simultaneously producing the projective
glued module, its constant rank, and both flat-cokernel clauses.  Keeping this assembly
generic isolates the remaining DD-4 geometry from the certificate bookkeeping.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra

namespace DivisorAdaptation

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))} [IsProper C.hom]
variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
variable {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
variable (A : DivisorAdaptation C R pi d)

omit [IsProper C.hom] in
/-- Assemble a divisor-family certificate from finite regular chart colengths and a
submodule which spans the residue-fibre kernels of the Cech difference map.

The overlap product is kept as an explicit finite-flat input: producing it from the
universal seed is part of the geometric base-change wiring, while all consequences for
the certificate are discharged here. -/
theorem isCertified_of_kernel_spanning [IsNoetherianRing R] {n : Nat}
    (hfin : forall j : A.index, Module.Finite R (A.colength j))
    (hregular : forall (j : A.index) (p : PrimeSpectrum R),
      (A.eqn j ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
          Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces j) ⊗[R] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ∈
        nonZeroDivisors
          (Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces j) ⊗[R] p.asIdeal.ResidueField))
    (hovlFinite : Module.Finite R A.ovlProd)
    (hovlFlat : Module.Flat R A.ovlProd)
    (L : Submodule R A.chartProd)
    (hle : L <= LinearMap.ker (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight))
    (hspan : forall p : PrimeSpectrum R,
      LinearMap.ker ((A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight).rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField) <=
        LinearMap.range (L.subtype.rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField))
    (hdim : forall p : PrimeSpectrum R,
      Module.finrank p.asIdeal.ResidueField
          (LinearMap.ker
            ((A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight).baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) = n) :
    A.IsCertified n := by
  letI hfiniteColength : forall j : A.index, Module.Finite R (A.colength j) := hfin
  letI hprojectiveColength : forall j : A.index, Module.Projective R (A.colength j) :=
    fun j => A.projective_colength_of_forall_tmul_residueField j (hregular j)
  letI hflatColength : forall j : A.index, Module.Flat R (A.colength j) :=
    fun j => A.flat_colength_of_forall_tmul_residueField j (hregular j)
  letI hfiniteChart : Module.Finite R A.chartProd := Module.Finite.pi
  letI hflatChart : Module.Flat R A.chartProd := Module.Flat.pi_of_finite
  letI hfiniteOvl : Module.Finite R A.ovlProd := hovlFinite
  letI hflatOvl : Module.Flat R A.ovlProd := hovlFlat
  have hfiniteGlued : Module.Finite R A.Glued :=
    Module.Finite.iff_fg.mpr (_root_.IsNoetherian.noetherian A.gluedSubmodule)
  have hprojectiveGlued : Module.Projective R A.Glued :=
    Module.Projective.ker_of_forall_ker_rTensor_residueField_le
      (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight) L hle hspan
  refine
    { finite_colength := hfin
      projective_colength := fun j => hprojectiveColength j
      finite_glued := hfiniteGlued
      projective_glued := hprojectiveGlued
      rankAtStalk_glued := fun p =>
        Module.rankAtStalk_ker_eq_of_forall_finrank_eq
          (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight) L hle hspan n hdim p
      flat_coker_incl :=
        Module.Flat.quotient_ker_of_forall_ker_rTensor_residueField_le
          (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight) L hle hspan
      flat_coker_diff :=
        Module.Flat.quotient_range_of_forall_ker_rTensor_residueField_le
          (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight) L hle hspan }

# DD-4 — the seed section is a fibre kernel witness of the `K`-side-component map

For any theta generator seed `D` the candidate generator `sec z` lies in `K` (`sec_mem`)

survives fibrewise — i.e. `ThetaGeneratorSeed.FibreInjective z` is *false* for any seed

section GenericFibre

variable {R₀ : Type u} [CommRing R₀] {M N : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R₀ M]
  [AddCommGroup N] [Module R₀ N]

/-- **The generic fibre-injectivity equivalence** (the pure linear algebra behind
`hsub ⟺ hinj`, at any base prime): for an `R₀`-linear map `f : M → N`, the residue fibre of
the range inclusion `range f ↪ N` is injective iff the residue fibre of the injectivization
`f̄ = (ker f).liftQ f : M ⧸ ker f → N` is injective.  The two differ only by the (always
bijective) corestriction equivalence `ē : M ⧸ ker f ≃ range f`, so `f̄ ⊗ κ` and
`(range f).subtype ⊗ κ` are interchangeable through `ē ⊗ κ`.

This is the level-agnostic form of the landed piece-level equivalence
(`ThetaGeneratorSeed.hsub_of_forall_liftQ_rTensor_injective` /
`hinj_of_forall_sideColengthSubmodule_subtype_rTensor_injective`); the carve pin may target
whichever of the two is cleanest and still discharge the other. -/
theorem liftQ_rTensor_injective_iff_range_subtype_rTensor_injective
    (f : M →ₗ[R₀] N) (p : PrimeSpectrum R₀) :
    Function.Injective
        (((LinearMap.ker f).liftQ f le_rfl).rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField)
      ↔ Function.Injective
        ((LinearMap.range f).subtype.rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField) := by
  set fbar := (LinearMap.ker f).liftQ f le_rfl with hfbar
  have hfbar_inj : Function.Injective fbar := by
    rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, hfbar]
    exact Submodule.ker_liftQ_eq_bot' _ f rfl
  have hrange : LinearMap.range fbar = LinearMap.range f := by
    rw [hfbar, Submodule.range_liftQ]
  set g := fbar.codRestrict (LinearMap.range f)
    (fun x => hrange ▸ LinearMap.mem_range_self fbar x) with hg
  have hgcomp : (LinearMap.range f).subtype ∘ₗ g = fbar :=
    LinearMap.subtype_comp_codRestrict _ _ _
  have hg_inj : Function.Injective g := by
    rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, hg, LinearMap.ker_codRestrict, LinearMap.ker_eq_bot]
    exact hfbar_inj
  have hg_surj : Function.Surjective g := by
    rw [← LinearMap.range_eq_top, hg, LinearMap.range_codRestrict, hrange,
      Submodule.comap_subtype_eq_top]
  set ebar := LinearEquiv.ofBijective g ⟨hg_inj, hg_surj⟩ with hebar
  have hfactor : fbar.rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField
      = (LinearMap.range f).subtype.rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField ∘ₗ
          g.rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField := by
    rw [← LinearMap.rTensor_comp, hgcomp]
  have hg_rTensor_bij : Function.Bijective (g.rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField) := by
    change Function.Bijective (ebar.toLinearMap.rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField)
    rw [← LinearEquiv.coe_rTensor]
    exact (LinearEquiv.rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField ebar).bijective
  rw [hfactor, LinearMap.coe_comp]
  exact Function.Injective.of_comp_iff' _ hg_rTensor_bij

end GenericFibre

/-- **The chart-level reading map** `f_V^b = relThetaResSide b (le_rfl) ∘ K.subtype`: reads a
